The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 624b287b6675a962), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. statement: Use the construction of Proposition 4.1 through order 2l, where l ≥ 1, and let Aleaf = A(0) be the area jet of its minimal first leaf. Then every coefficient below degree 2l of mAH(G) − b∗(Aleaf) vanishes, and  mAH(G) − b∗(Aleaf)  2l = 1 16π Z ∞ 0 N(s) Z {s}×S2  |k|2 + |U|2 + 2FJ0 s F  dAg0 ds ≥ 0.
